observable: RMSE (Root Mean Square Error) of heart rate monitoring during 30 minutes of moderate-intensity cycling
baseline: RMSE of heart rate monitoring using a standard photoplethysmographic sensor without motion artifact reduction
conditions: The Nucleus device is used in conjunction with a cycling ergometer, and the subject's arm is moved in a controlled manner to simulate real-world exercise conditions
falsifier: If the RMSE of heart rate monitoring using the Nucleus device is not significantly lower than the baseline (p < 0.05) after 30 minutes of moderate-intensity cycling
